original_test_intent: Verify that F11 at the POST hint opens the intended boot-selection menu on the identified host while BIOS version/release date remain readable and correct.
original_method: Bind host/console, expected values and menu, approve one reboot, capture the F11 prompt, have an operator press only F11, capture the intended boot menu and fields, then exit without selecting an unapproved device and verify normal boot.
manual_activity: Human operator must focus the correct pre-OS console, press F11 at its prompt, verify the intended boot menu and values, and exit without selecting an unapproved device.
required_inputs: Expected BIOS version/release date and boot-menu reference
Physical or validated remote pre-OS input/capture
POST timing and no-selection exit plan
safety_requirements: Do not select unapproved boot media
Stop on wrong menu/path or recovery failure
No automatic retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Report without claiming key action or final verdict
engineer_actions: Exit without selection and own verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly states ordinary SSH cannot prove F11 or the rendered boot-selection menu.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain operator-driven F11 menu entry through a physical or validated pre-OS console; automation may preserve/correlate evidence only.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: F11, prompt timing, version/date, boot-menu entry and 5/5-minute timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture one continuous sequence from F11 prompt to intended menu and safe no-selection exit, with readable expected values.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds menu identity, boot-target exclusion and recovery traceability.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; this does not claim any device was booted.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong focus or accidental selection can alter the boot path.

project_override_considerations: Project may approve physical or remote console, but must preserve F11-specific timing, intended menu/value evidence and no-unapproved-selection boundary.
expected_evidence: Readable intended boot-selection menu and values

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require F11-driven boot-menu entry plus correct POST information.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The manual purpose is clear; reference, console/operator and reboot approval are readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Defines the no-selection boundary and makes menu identity plus version/date evidence auditable without broadening into boot-device testing.
independent_technical_reasoning: The acceptance core is prompt-timed human input and visual verification of a pre-OS menu. Although capture handling may be automated, no OS command establishes this interaction, so MANUAL ONLY remains correct.
